home.tagline: What things cost in Pakistan, weekly — and what they'll cost next week.
home.subtitle: Prices from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics weekly survey, made tidy, with honest one-week forecasts and a published record of how wrong we've been.

scorecard.title: Scorecard
scorecard.intro: Every forecast this system has made, against what actually happened. MASE below 1 beats the naive seasonal forecast; coverage should be ≈ 80%.

drift.title: Drift log
drift.intro: When the world moves — a supply shock, a policy step — the model's inputs and residuals move too. Every check, fired or not, is logged here with a note a journalist could quote.

model.intro: The champion, its backtest, and every promotion decision — including the rejections.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.collect: We collect nothing. Bhao has no accounts, no sign-in, no analytics, no tracking cookies, and no advertising. We do not know who you are, and we do not want to know.
privacy.storage: The only data stored on your device is a small preference (your chosen city, so the app opens where you left it) and a standard offline cache, so pages and the latest known prices work without a connection. Clearing your browser storage removes both.
privacy.server: Our server keeps standard, anonymous access logs (IP address, requested page, timestamp) for rate limiting and abuse prevention only. They are not sold, shared, or used to profile anyone.
privacy.data: All price data comes from public sources: the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics weekly Sensitive Price Indicator (public official statistics, attributed per row) and WFP/HDX monthly food prices (an existing open dataset, attributed). Forecasts are model output with published error rates — not financial advice.
privacy.contact: Questions or takedown requests: open an issue on the project repository.
